subject: CloudShelf listing syndication & commercial MOU
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Paul D'Angelo <paul@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: CloudShelf listing syndication & commercial MOU

Hi Paul,

Thanks again for introducing CloudShelf's partnerships team last week — great to hear about the traction you've been seeing with analytics ISVs in Q4. Quick note to kick off a workstream for listing syndication: Redwood wants to make sure the listing on the CloudShelf catalog includes co-sell entitlements and that our meter/billing mapping is clear before we publish.

Proposed next steps (small, actionable):
- Agree commercial handshake (rev share / referral model) and capture in a short MOU
- Confirm technical evidence for listing (billing meter, telemetry tags, integration guide)
- Prepare a single shared artifact for marketplace teams (one-page launch checklist)

Can you attach your SOW / draft terms and point us to the CloudShelf engineering contact for metering integration? If you can loop in legal for a quick MOU review, that would be helpful — we have a one-page terms doc we can propose.

I copied Ben for go-to-market + co-sell motions and Vivek for any platform integration questions. Let us know if Wed or Thu afternoon PST works for a 30-min sync.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Paul D'Angelo <paul@cloudbridge.com>

On Tue, Dec 8, 2026 at 9:32 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Paul,
>
> Thanks again for introducing CloudShelf's partnerships team last week...

Hi Marissa — thanks, and great to kick this off.

Quick answers:
- I've attached our preliminary SOW and a short commercial worksheet for rev share scenarios. See CloudBridge_SOW_draft.pdf.
- Engineering contact for metering is Lina Zhao (lina@cloudshelf.ai); she owns the catalog ingestion API and metering spec. I'll introduce her on the thread after your review.
- Legal: I'll loop in our counsel (partners@cloudshelf.ai will escalate to legal) but we are fine to start with an MOU + one-pager.

Wed 3pm PST works for me; if that suits Vivek and Ben we'll lock it.

Two asks for the sync so we can be efficient:
1) An example payload or doc describing Redwood's expected metering keys and event cadence (so Lina knows what to expect).
2) Any required security/compliance evidence for the catalog listing (e.g., SOC2 summary, data residency constraints).

Best,
Paul D'Angelo
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
paul@cloudbridge.com

Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudShelf listing syndication & commercial MOU

Thanks Paul — appreciate the SOW and the intro. Lina — great to meet you (looping you on Paul’s note).

Ben / Vivek — please see Paul’s SOW; I uploaded a one-page handshake doc (redwood-listing-terms-v1.docx) that outlines: entitlement mapping, revenue share bands, basic SLA commitments for listing uptime, and a 60-day marketing cadence for launch.

For the technical ask, Vivek: can your team produce the lightweight metering payload spec Paul requested? If we can give Lina a concrete JSON schema (or a sample event stream) ahead of the call, it will save time. Also confirm whether our public instance needs a separate metering token or if we can use a scoped enterprise token.

For the sync I propose 30 min Thu 3:00pm PST. Agenda: 1) commercial handshake review (10m) 2) technical ingestion & metering mapping (15m) 3) launch checklist & next steps (5m).

Marissa
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudShelf listing syndication & commercial MOU

On Wed, Dec 9, 2026 at 3:02 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> For the technical ask, Vivek: can your team produce the lightweight metering payload spec Paul requested?

Hi all — quick technical update ahead of tomorrow's sync.

We can provide a payload spec and a sample event stream. High-level notes:
- Preferred meter model: per-token inference units + embedding units; include model id and quantization tag.
- Ingestion: catalog accepts batched JSON events (up to 500 events / call). We will share a sample JSON and a small Postman collection.
- Auth: enterprise integrations should use a scoped API key; public listings can use a limited-time token for demo mode.
- Security/compliance evidence: SOC2 summary + mapping available; Ben will follow up with the catalog team on any additional attestation.

I'll upload the JSON schema to the shared doc and add a Postman example: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-MAP

See you on the call — Vivek will present the tech piece and Ben will cover go-to-market runway.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
